collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page, the pricing-limits resource page and the public pricing page (English) around 10:38 Beijing time / 02:38Z on 2026-11-18: https://commandcode.ai/docs/plans/goat, https://commandcode.ai/docs/resources/pricing-limits and https://commandcode.ai/pricing, read as published. The RSC payload (model catalog + budgetUsd rows on the plan page; models + planBudgetUsd / planAllowanceUsd / availability on the pricing-limits page), the rendered plan-page model tables (context, prices, monthly credits, caps) and the official 'Estimated requests' table were read field by field, and the same three pages captured on 2026-11-17 were compared on budgetUsd / rates / shape / timeOfDay per model. One new paid GOAT model observed (Tencent Hy4). Two non-GOAT catalog additions on the pricing-limits page (GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol) are recorded only as out-of-scope observations. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One new paid model observed on 2026-11-18: 'Tencent Hy4' (slug hy4, plan-page id and pricing-limits id both 'tencent/hy4'). Vendor Tencent, category opensource, blurb 'long-horizon agentic coding with image understanding', launchedAt 2026-11-04, minPlanName Go, context 1,024,000 tokens, reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored' (intelligenceIndex and codingIndex unpublished). Priced $0.834 input / $2.501 output / $0.042 cached read per 1M tokens with no cache-write price listed. GOAT per-model monthly credits budgetUsd 20 (credits column '$20'). pricing-limits planBudgetUsd / planAllowanceUsd = {go: 6, goat: 20, pro: 30}. Official estimated requests on the plan page: 1,220 / 5h, 3,060 / week, 6,120 / month (identical to the already-listed Tencent Hy4 Preview row, which has the same three-part price and $20 GOAT credits). Availability includes individual-go / individual-goat / individual-pro. The GOAT plan page counters moved All plans 103 -> 106, GOAT plan 75 -> 76; Deals stayed 4 and Free stayed 3. The pricing-limits All counter moved 105 -> 108. Other previously listed paid GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / shape (GLM-5.3 stays at budgetUsd 70). Shared-pool wording did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no adopted.csv row.

previousCapture.note: The 2026-11-17 baseline is the same-pages capture used for goat-hy4-flash-round1-2026-11-17.json / goat-qwen4-max-round1-2026-11-17.json. That capture already listed Tencent Hy4 Flash and Tencent Hy4 Preview, but had no paid 'Tencent Hy4' row (id tencent/hy4).

tencentHy4.note: No 'Tencent Hy4' row (id tencent/hy4, slug hy4) existed in the official GOAT catalog on 2026-11-17. Tencent Hy4 Flash (tencent/hy4-flash, budgetUsd 15) and Tencent Hy4 Preview (tencent/hy4-preview, budgetUsd 20) were already present.

glm53.note: GLM-5.3 keeps budgetUsd 70 on both the 2026-11-17 and the 2026-11-18 plan-page payloads; its rates, request shape and timeOfDay are unchanged.

diff.note: Compared with the 2026-11-17 capture of the same pages, the only paid GOAT catalog change is the addition of 'Tencent Hy4'. Every other paid GOAT row keeps the same budgetUsd / rates / shape; GLM-5.3 stays at budgetUsd 70. The plan-page paid budgetUsd rows grew 64 -> 65. The pricing-limits page also added GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, which are not available on the GOAT plan (see otherObservations).

otherObservations.topic: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol added on pricing-limits, not on GOAT
otherObservations.observation: The pricing-limits catalog grew by three rows: Tencent Hy4 plus GPT-6.2 Astra (id gpt-6.2-astra, contextWindow 1,050,000, individual-goat false, individual-pro false, individual-max true, individual-ultra true) and GPT-6.2 Sol (id gpt-6.2-sol, contextWindow 1,050,000, individual-goat false, individual-pro true, individual-max true). Neither GPT-6.2 model is available on the GOAT plan. The public /pricing page does not list Tencent Hy4 or either GPT-6.2 model. totalReleases on /pricing moved 428 -> 432; nowMs moved 1794883145327 -> 1794969501345. The visible dollar-amount set on /pricing is unchanged.
